subject: Re: Holiday pass codes for November newsletter — segmentation & delivery
messages:
From: Jessica Marshall <jessica.marshall@aiweek.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@aiweek.org
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 12:15:00 -0500
Subject: Holiday passes for our Nov newsletter — need 500 codes

Hey Marissa,

Hope you're well — AIWeek is running a special holiday subscriber send the first week of Dec and we'd love to include a Redwood gift: 500 single-use access passes (trial credits / promo codes) to be distributed across our subscriber base. Two asks:

- Can we get codes segmented by region (US / EU / APAC) so we can tailor redemption windows?
- We need the codes delivered as a CSV with a simple code + expiry + tier flag (no personal PII).

Also: what billing line should we expect and is there any way to split fulfillment across two delivery windows (Dec 1 and Dec 8)?

Happy to sign whatever paperwork — sending ops on cc for delivery logistics.

Thanks,
Jessica
Jessica Marshall
Partnerships Manager, AIWeek
jessica.marshall@aiweek.org
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Marshall <jessica.marshall@aiweek.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Holiday passes for our Nov newsletter — need 500 codes

Thanks Jessica — excited to partner on the holiday send. Looping in Ben from Ops for generation/format and Lauren on approvals. Quick responses below so we can keep your deadlines: 

- Segmentation: we can split the 500 into up to 3 buckets (US / EU / APAC). Confirm the counts you want or we can suggest (300 / 150 / 50) based on past open rates.
- Delivery format: we prefer a simple CSV (code, expiry_iso, bucket). I'll attach our template.
- Delivery windows: yes — we can do a split delivery on Dec 1 and Dec 8; tell us which bucket goes in each window.
- Billing/cover: for partner newsletter co-promos we usually provide a mix of trial-extension codes + full feature passes. Need internal sign-off on total cost.

Ben — can you confirm we have inventory and that the redemption windows can be enforced per-bucket? Also can you generate the CSV by end of week if Lauren signs off?

Lauren — pinging you for cost approval and any guardrails (per-user limits, expiry length).

Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: promo_codes_template.csv (attachment/csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Holiday passes for our Nov newsletter — need 500 codes

Marissa — we can support this. Notes from Ops: 

- Generation: we can produce 500 single-use codes and tag them with bucket metadata; delivery as two CSVs (Dec 1 and Dec 8) is straightforward.
- Enforcement: redemption window and per-account one-time redemption are enforceable via our promo service. Expiry defaults to 60 days unless specified.
- Throttling: recommend staggering the Dec 1 batch over 3 hours to avoid sudden spikes on hosted endpoints.
- Attachment: attached is the promo_codes_template.csv with columns (code, expiry_iso, bucket, notes). Please confirm final counts.

We don't need a signature DocuSign for this one; internal approval email is sufficient. Accounting will post a one-line credit against AWS/marketing spend.

Ben Carter
Manager, Customer Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachment: promo_codes_template.csv (attachment/csv)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Holiday passes for our Nov newsletter — need 500 codes

Marissa / Ben — approved with constraints. Approve issuing 500 codes split as follows: 280 US / 140 EU / 80 APAC. Rationale: typical opens + timezone-adjusted redemption. Constraints: 

- Cost cap: marketing credit for this program is capped at $6,000 (estimate). If expected redemptions exceed budget, hit me before release.
- Expiry: set to 75 days from delivery to give attendees enough runway.
- Per-account limit: one code per account enforced.

Ben — proceed to generate with expiry set to 2027-03-15T23:59:59Z and staggered release (US batch Dec 1; EU+APAC split Dec 8). Marissa — confirm segmentation to Jessica and we can finalize CSVs.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Growth Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Marshall <jessica.marshall@aiweek.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, ops@aiweek.org
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Holiday passes for our Nov newsletter — need 500 codes

Jessica — good news, we're approved. Summary and next steps: 

- Codes: 500 single-use gift passes have been generated. Split: 280 US / 140 EU / 80 APAC.
- Expiry: 2027-03-15T23:59:59Z.
- Delivery schedule: US batch will be delivered to your ops inbox on Dec 1 morning (we'll stagger the rollout across 3 hours). EU and APAC batches will be delivered on Dec 8.
- Format: CSVs with columns (code, expiry_iso, bucket). See attached: holiday_gift_passes_2026.csv (contains only masked codes for this thread; full file delivered via secure link to ops on Dec 1).
- Billing: covered under marketing co-op credit; accounting will reflect a $0 invoice to AIWeek and a $6,000 internal marketing charge (no customer billing).

Actions for you: confirm the two delivery windows are good and which segment you want on Dec 8 (we recommend EU morning / APAC evening). Once you confirm, Ben will push the files and we'll share the secure download link with ops.

Thanks — excited to see the engagement this drives.

Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: holiday_gift_passes_2026.csv (attachment/csv)
